annotations.title: Get an event and its markets

description: Use when an agent needs the full detail of a single prediction-market event by its composite key (source + event_id). Returns the event with all of its child markets, latest probabilities, and metadata. The canonical URL `https://pdata.world/events/{source}/{event_id}` is stable for the lifetime of the underlying market. Events that closed more than 10 days ago are removed from the live tables; the same URL then returns a `kind: "tombstone"` object holding the title, close date and final outcome of each top market instead of the live `kind: "live"` object. Check `kind` before reading any other field. Large events carry hundreds of markets (a 311-market event is ~520 KB); pass `markets_limit` to take only the first N.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.
event_id.title: Event Id

markets_limit.description: Return only the first N markets, in the order described under `markets`; `markets_total` still counts all of them. Omit to get every market. Ignored for a tombstone.
markets_limit.title: Markets Limit

source.description: Platform ID: polymarket / kalshi / manifold / myriad / limitless / predict / opinion / gemini.
source.title: Source
